name: amurites_warrior
description: an Amurite Warrior (Fall from Heaven), a bearded human clubman: wild black hair with a white headband, a short black beard, a royal-blue tunic with white trim and white star motifs, a purple sash over his left shoulder, a brown belt with a silver buckle, dark blue trousers and brown leather boots, a brass-banded wooden club in his RIGHT hand and a round blue shield with a silver star and a silver rim on his LEFT arm
hands: the club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the club is lifted beside the head with its brass-banded head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the brass-banded club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the round blue shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the club is level, its brass-banded head pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the brass-banded club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the round blue shield swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the club carries on down until its brass-banded head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, wild black hair trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the club comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the round blue shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, the round blue shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the club dipping, the round blue shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the round blue shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's brass-banded head resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round blue shield lies flat beside him
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the club and the round blue shield on the ground beside him
